title: Charged without my accept
body: I just had a withdrawal from my bank account even though I cancelled my subscription and no answer from support?!
author: Tanjasia

title: DONT DO IT
body:
For an app thats supposed to help people with ADHD, they are taking advantage of it instead. 

I did the test because it popped up on my Instagram (targeting people with ADHD).
I accepted the TRIAL period only and I have now UNWILLINGLY paid them (a lot of money) for many months without knowing.

I have now just realized it and sent them an email- will report back here if they don’t accommodate. 

So sad to experience an app, I hoped would help, ended up costing me so much money without getting anything out of it.
An actual scam.
author: Amaevn

title: Too expensive
body: I got really excited when I downloaded the app and filled out all the questions, only to realize that is was soooooo expensive… Kind of a bummer
author: Bene0438

title: The low rate is ONLY due to monthly cost
body:
I’ve used ADHD Angel app for years, and while I can definitely see a lot of good features and helpful functions in this app - AND I find it not only fully fair but also self evident that a more complex app developed, the higher the price, whether as subscription or one-time only.

But this app is Too expensive, approximately 350 DKK per month.

I’d get the idea with acces to professional help in the app - but I’d love if it was possible to subscribe to a version without the vast (and very impressing!) extra “perks”.

Also because , while I’m that privileged to live a place where people with disabilities can actually get help through our national taxed health care system (with exactly learning me how to execute etc), affordable medication etc.,  plus, I’ve done a lot to understand my “trigger” points etc (but being nerdy also helps psycho-education). 

But I have  no doubt that this app could make a great and vital difference for many people but who might couldn’t spare that cost in budget to put into this app.

Well that was LONG, if you read through: thanks 🙏
